entries.en: Close your eyes. The end will be swift.
entries.ro: Închide ochii. Sfârșitul va fi rapid.

entries.en: My face is the last you will see.
entries.ro: Fața mea e ultima pe care o vei vedea.

entries.en: Good. Let's even the odds a little.
